tools.name: create_project
tools.description: Register sources (YouTube urls, web page urls, or upload ids) and start analysis. Charged per source. Does not produce a note.

tools.name: create_note
tools.description: Start writing a note from a project. Returns a note id immediately; the body is not written yet.

tools.name: get_note
tools.description: Read a note. While the body is still being written the note comes back with status generating.

tools.name: get_project
tools.description: Read a project and the sources in it.

tools.name: list_projects
tools.description: List the projects in the account, newest first.

tools.name: get_transcript
tools.description: Read a source transcript. Also serves as a poll for source analysis.
